fullDesc: From July 1 to 3, 1863 Union and Confederate armies fought at Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, with some 50,000 casualties in three days. Robert E. Lee's army retreated, and Lincoln later gave the Gettysburg Address there.
realFacts: Pickett's Charge failed on the last day
Vicksburg fell to Grant the next day
It was the largest battle in North America
